'''Phu''' was a world inhabited by the [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of aliens.<ref name="TCSWE" /><ref name="NoP" /> It was located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]],<ref name="EAOC" /> near the [[Aur system/Legends|Aur system]].<ref name="EGtW:AC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> Phu was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] famous for its gambling industry.<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|I am here to&hellip; a recent incident in the Phu system. We are still analyzing the data from the attack, but we can confirm that General Ares Nune's task force did encounter enemy forces on patrol.|[[Unidentified Republic admiral|A Republic admiral]]|<ref name="HoloNet News">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided}}</ref>}}
Phu was colonized millennia ago by the [[Bardottan/Legends|Bardottans]] of [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]].<ref name="NoP" /> Bardottans from Phu were known as Phuii.<ref name="TCSWE" /> They were known to be not as secretive or isolationist as those from the species' homeworld.<ref name="NoP" /> Phu was the homeworld of [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] pilots [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]]<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> and [[Chros-filik]].<ref name="BF:H">''[[Boba Fett: Hunted]]''</ref>

The planet remained neutral during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="FF139">{{FactFile|139|WOR 1-2|Worlds of the Clone Wars}}</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fleet, under command of [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune]], was patrolling the system when it was [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|attacked]] and destroyed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] superweapon [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].<ref name="TCW:S" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Phu was originally created as the Phuii species homeworld.<ref name="TCSWE" /> However, after the release of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars TV series'']], Phuii were eventually identified as Bardottans and Phu retconned as a colony of Bardotta.<ref name="NoP" />
